## Contribution rules for jaegertracing/jaeger

- For non-trivial changes, open or find an issue and agree on the approach first. (https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/blob/HEAD/CONTRIBUTING_GUIDELINES.md#L23)
- Tick the AI-usage checkbox in the PR template (exactly one option). (https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/blob/HEAD/AI_POLICY.md#L39)
- A human must write replies to review comments; do not generate or post them. (https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/blob/HEAD/AI_POLICY.md#L29)
- Sign off every commit (`git commit -s`) with the human's name and email, never the agent's. (https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/blob/HEAD/CONTRIBUTING.md#L63)
- Run the tests locally before opening or updating the PR. (https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/blob/HEAD/AI_POLICY.md#L28)
- Be able to explain every line of the change yourself. (https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/blob/HEAD/AI_POLICY.md#L13)
- Review and verify AI output yourself before asking for review. (https://github.com/jaegertracing/jaeger/blob/HEAD/CONTRIBUTING_GUIDELINES.md#L127)
